meta.name: syn3a_core
meta.note_zh: 每個參數都帶 source；source 以 CATALOG id + DOI 標示，非文獻值一律標 ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED 或 ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK/DERIVED。
meta.note_en: Every parameter carries a source. Non-literature values are tagged ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED or ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK/DERIVED.

genome_bp.source: C0715 10.7554/elife.36842 'chromosome of a 543,379 bp genome in a 400 nm spherical cell'

n_mrna_genes_full.source: C0862 'degrade all 452 mRNA, and translate all 452 mRNA into proteins'

ribosome_active_fraction.source: C0862 'on average, 220 of the 503 ribosomes, roughly 45% of ribosomes, are active'

cell_radius_nm.source: C0715 '400 nm spherical cell' (diameter) -> radius 200 nm

doubling_time_experimental_s.source: C0715/C0862 'JCVI-syn3A has a doubling time of 105 min'

tx_elongation_nt_per_s.source: C5382 10.3389/fmolb.2019.00130 'of 25 nt/s are used for kcat'

tl_elongation_aa_per_s.source: C5382 'with an elongation rate of 2 aa/sec'

mrna_half_life_s.source: C5382 'A messenger halflife of 4 min is used for all mRNA degradation'

atp_per_bp_replication.source: C0862 'DNA replication uses 1 ATP as an energy molecule per bp'

atp_fraction_precursor_transport.source: C0715 'only spend 9% of its produced ATP on precursor transport and processing'

surface_area_contribution_ratio.source: C0862 'maintain a rough 55% to 45% surface area contribution ratio'

atp_per_glucose_glycolysis.source: ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK net glycolysis yield; C0862 states syn3A 'depends almost entirely on glycolysis for formation of ATP'

atp_per_nt_transcription.source: ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK (NTP polymerisation ~2 high-energy phosphates per nt)

atp_per_aa_translation.source: ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK (2 ATP charging + 2 GTP elongation per peptide bond)

adenylate_pool.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (founder ATP+ADP; from 2026-11-23 kept proportional to membrane lipids by nucleotide salvage, C0715 salvage-only nucleotide metabolism; salvage ATP cost ASSUMED 0)

k_glucose_per_transporter_per_s.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (set so ATP supply exceeds demand; verified by the gate M2 shortfall check)

k_lipid_per_enzyme_per_s.source: CALIBRATED-TO-C0715-DOUBLING-TIME (geometric bisection so the median doubling time = 105 min; recalibrated 2026-11-23 by Grok Bot ALife Project - Andreeva after the balanced-growth founder and adenylate-salvage fix: 6294 s at this value, bracket 0.08-0.4; previous value 0.0607 was for the old 503-per-gene founder). Not an independent prediction.

k_replication_bp_per_s.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (replisome rate; syn3A value not in the local library)

atp_km.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (Michaelis constant on ATP for biosynthesis)

n_core_genes.source: Plan 44 D4 decision: core subset of 50-100 genes

protein_per_mrna_class_fraction.source: DERIVED gene class split 20/20/10/10 of 60 core genes

communication_step_s.source: C0862 'we used a communication time step of 1 s'

glycolysis_atp_priming_km.source: ESTIMATE-UNMEASURED (mechanism ASSUMED-TEXTBOOK: glycolysis invests ATP at hexokinase/PFK before paying back, so ATP production needs ATP > 0; added 2026-11-23 for Plan 45 P8)

death_atp_fraction.source: ASSUMED Plan 45 E2 decision: dead when ATP < 5% of initial for N consecutive steps; sensitivity 1/5/10% measured in P8

death_consecutive_steps.source: ASSUMED Plan 45 E2 decision: 60 consecutive 1 s steps; sensitivity 30/60/120 measured in P8

rod_radius_um.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'The cell radius is R = 0.5 um' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

rod_birth_length_um.source: ASSUMED (newborn rod length so that the Min field has its length scale; Huang 2003 simulates L = 4 um cells; the cell model's membrane-area growth is mapped onto this rod)

min_D_um2_s.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'DD = DE = 2.5 um2/sec' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_sigma_exch_s.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'sigma_D ADP->ATP = 1/sec' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_sigma_D_um_s.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'sigma_D = 0.025 um/sec' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_sigma_dD_um3_s.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'sigma_dD = 0.0015 um3/sec' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_sigma_de_s.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'sigma_de = 0.7/sec' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_sigma_E_um3_s.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'sigma_E = 0.093 um3/sec' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_mind_per_um.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'total concentrations of MinD and MinE are 1,000/um and 350/um' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_mine_per_um.source: Huang, Meir & Wingreen 2003 PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2135445100 'total concentrations of MinD and MinE are 1,000/um and 350/um' (E. coli value; syn3A has no Min system: used for a Min-reconstituted artificial cell as in C6322 Godino 2019)

min_window_s.source: ASSUMED numerical: Min simulated for 220 s at the division length (about 5 periods of the cited ~40 s)

min_burnin_s.source: ASSUMED numerical: first 60 s discarded before time-averaging MinD

mutation_rate_per_locus.source: ASSUMED (M5/M6 genome theta mutation probability per daughter per locus)

mutation_sigma.source: ASSUMED (Gaussian step of a theta mutation, theta in [0,1])

evolution_dt_s.source: ASSUMED compute step for M6 (cited communication step is 1 s, C0862); validated against dt = 1 s in m6_dt_validation.jsonl

weakened_class_tx_multiplier.source: ASSUMED Plan 44 M6 control: transcription of the essential lipid-synthesis (membrane) gene class halved

m5_mutation_rate_per_locus.source: ASSUMED (M5 lineage trees only: high enough that the measured rate has about 2% statistical error, so the 10% L-A4 check is meaningful)
